shadows.name: quiet-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates one primary object from the canvas.

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Appears only during hover or keyboard focus.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: No translation, tracking, breathing, or looping.

components.name: Primary Destination
components.description: The one strongest next step in a section.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:.72rem 1rem; border:1px solid #0f766e; border-radius:7px; background:#0f766e; color:#fbfaf7; font:700 .8rem/1.3 'Maple Mono NF CN',monospace; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),background-color 280ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#115e59; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Quiet Destination
components.description: A supporting path that stays visually quieter.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:.72rem 1rem; border:1px solid #ded8cd; border-radius:7px; background:#f2efe9; color:#0f766e; font:700 .8rem/1.3 'Maple Mono NF CN',monospace; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),border-color 280ms ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { border-color:#0f766e; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Research Track
components.description: A directional research interest, not a generic feature card.
components.html:
Embodied AI

Agents that learn through action in the world.
components.css: .ds-track { display:grid; grid-template-columns:6px 1fr; gap:1rem; padding:1rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid #ded8cd; color:#27231f; } .ds-track__signal { border-radius:999px; background:#0f766e; } .ds-track strong { font:700 1rem/1.3 'Maple Mono NF CN',monospace; } .ds-track p { margin:.3rem 0 0; max-width:46ch; color:#6f675c; font:400 1rem/1.65 'LXGW WenKai Screen',sans-serif; } .ds-track:focus-within { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Profile Link
components.description: A compact identity or external destination link.
components.css: .ds-profile-link { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; min-height:44px; padding:.35rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid #ded8cd; color:#27231f; font:700 .8rem/1.3 'Maple Mono NF CN',monospace; text-decoration:none; transition:color 220ms ease,padding-left 280ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-profile-link:hover { padding-left:.35rem; color:#0f766e; } .ds-profile-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Resource Chip
components.description: A compact label for a real resource type.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:30px; padding:.2rem .58rem; border:1px solid #7dafaa; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#0f766e; font:700 .78rem/1.2 'Maple Mono NF CN',monospace; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 220ms ease,color 220ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background:#0f766e; color:#fbfaf7; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A low-noise navigation item with a positional cue.
components.html: HomeCV
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:1.25rem; border-bottom:1px solid #ded8cd; } .ds-nav__link { position:relative; min-height:44px; padding:.65rem 0; color:#27231f; font:700 .85rem/1.3 'Maple Mono NF CN',monospace; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color:#0f766e; } .ds-nav__link--active::after { content:''; position:absolute; right:0; bottom:-1px; left:0; height:2px; background:#0f766e; } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: 界面像一张正在使用的研究工作台：线索、兴趣与入口围绕一个鲜明的人格中心组织，而不是被平均分配进一组模板卡片。整体保持冷静的阅读秩序，用角色头像、不对称构图和少量机敏动效表达好奇与灵动。这个系统服务于个人品牌，而非传统学院模板。
keyCharacteristics: 角色资产是叙事主角，不是侧栏缩略图。
单色青绿负责导航与行动，暖黄只作微量性格信号。
信息以轨道、清单和开放布局组织，同构卡片只用于真正独立的对象。
动画集中在首屏编排、状态反馈与空间关系，内容默认始终可见。
移动端重新编排主次，不机械压缩桌面布局。

rules.name: The Sparse Signal Rule
rules.body: 强调色只标记行动、焦点与叙事线索；如果一个视口里每个边框都在发光，强调就已经失效。

rules.name: The Avatar Palette Rule
rules.body: 不从头像里机械复制整套青、黄、红色；页面用青绿建立身份，暖黄仅作一次呼应。

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: 标题与标签使用 Maple Mono，叙述使用霞鹜文楷；一个区块只能有一个主导声音。

rules.name: The No-Cropping Rule
rules.body: 标题必须在 320px 视口完整换行，禁止依赖隐藏溢出来维持构图。

rules.name: The Resting Surface Rule
rules.body: 同类内容在静止状态不同时拥有边框、宽阴影、渐变和光晕；最多选择一种主层级手段。

dos: Do 让角色头像、姓名和一句清晰定位共同占据首屏主要注意力。
Do 用不对称构图与不同信息密度建立节奏，而不是复制同尺寸卡片。
Do 确保内容在动画运行前就可见，JS 只增强已有呈现。
Do 将高频动画限制在 transform 与 opacity，并在离屏、隐藏标签页或减少动态环境中停止。
Do 在 320px、390px、768px、1024px 与 1440px 宽度检查标题、按钮、导航和角色图。
donts: Don't 回到通用 SaaS 落地页的重复卡片与渐变装饰。
Don't 使用杂志模板式的排版腔调代替真实个人气质。
Don't 使用廉价赛博霓虹、过量玻璃效果或让每个深色表面持续发光。
Don't 使用无意义的滚动淡入，让未进入视口的内容暂时不可见。
Don't 为同一身份在侧栏和首屏重复完整姓名、头像、简介与链接。
Don't 通过超过 16px 的卡片圆角、渐变文字或宽阴影加细边框制造高级感。
